title: Free Transform: Distort and Envelope modes (mesh warp)
description: DONE. Distort + Envelope mesh warp implemented end-to-end. Ground truth: ToolsPanel exposed 3 modes (rotate-scale/distort/envelope) and StageArea drew distort/envelope corner+edge handles, but the drag fell through to scale math (no warp) and there was no warp model/render path. Implemented: (1) core engine/warp.ts — ShapeWarp model (4 corners + 8 bezier edge controls), bilinear distort + Coons-patch envelope eval, warpShape geometry mapping w/ curve subdivision; ShapeWarp/WarpCorners/WarpEdges types on ShapeDisplayObject+DrawingObject; warp field in updateDisplayObject. (2) renderer.ts — warps shape geometry into stage space and draws directly when obj.warp set (supersedes affine). (3) StageArea — warp-handle hit test (corners always, edge controls in envelope), warpDragRef drag, warped mesh frame+handle render, onShapeWarp callback; Shell handleShapeWarp -> updateDisplayObject({warp}). (4) Tests: engine/__tests__/warp.test.ts (13 tests, all pass). Build green all 7 packages. core suite: 5250 pass, only 2-3 pre-existing failures from missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla (task 1207). authoring-ui suite: 639 pass. Docs: docs/04-toolbox.md updated.
